about_short_description.short_description: Protocol Labs is a research, development, and deployment lab for network protocols.

product.name: Filecoin
product.description: A decentralized storage network that provides an open service for data storage and retrieval, built on top of the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS).

product.name: IPFS
product.description: The InterPlanetary File System is a peer-to-peer network protocol designed to make the web faster, safer, and more open by enabling decentralized file storage and sharing.

product.name: libp2p
product.description: A modular network stack that enables the development of peer-to-peer applications by providing a set of protocols for building decentralized networks.

product.name: Protocol Labs Venture Studio (PL VS)
product.description: An initiative supporting the growth of startups building on technologies like Filecoin and IPFS, offering resources such as market research, product design, and capital.

product.name: Interplanetary Consensus (IPC)
product.description: A scaling solution for web3 applications, using a recursive tree of blockchains to support planetary-scale applications.

product.name: DeStor
product.description: A cloud storage platform that simplifies data onboarding to the Filecoin Network for large-scale enterprise clients.
